Name: Sweet Fashion - Fashion Sense pack for Sweet Farmer
Author: HeartOfFlowers
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53551/53551-1792030941-95496384.png[/img]
[center][color=#444444][size=1][i]Caption: "Sweet Fashion : Something for everyone" many different farmers with different heights and clothes.[/i][/size][/color][/center]

[center][size=6][font=Courier New][i][b]Sweet Fashion[/b][/i][/font][/size][/center]
Hi ! This mod is a Fashion Sense pack created for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53548]Sweet Farmer[/url], a passion project of mine that I spent months creating with love! This pack aims to give you a bit of everything and hopefully you'll find something for you in here![b] This mod will be updated a few times more to add a few more hairstyles! [/b]If you'd like to know when new FS packs for this farmer will be released, please join my tiny [url=https://discord.gg/GqgZB5cmJp]Discord Server [/url]which is the preferred cite to report bugs, as well as giving you a space to show off your creations! I hope to see you there, have fun!
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]This mod includes:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]All items were designed to be coloreable, including multiple coloring layers![/b][/*]
[*]32 unique shirts and 14 recolors. Each one of them are divided into 2, Gender Neutral (GN) and Sweet (S), which means you can have a flat or visible chest. Aditionally there's a version for the Long Torso (GNL/SL)![/*]
[*]29 hairs with 2 variations, a warm and a cold one! The Cold (C) one suits green, cyan, blues, purples, blacks and dark browns, and the Warm (W) one suits pinks, reds, oranges, fantasy colors, blondes and light browns! You get best of both worlds, dark rich tones and the vibrant pastels you deserve! No muddy colors here. The hairs are tagged by texture, length and Cold or Warm.[/*]
[*]This mod adds [b]Modular Bangs[/b] to the game, using the [b]accessory[/b] button in FS, you get access to many different bangs with different textures to fit all hairs! You also get [b]Modular Extras,[/b] which means you can add ponytails, buns and strands to your farmer without having to equip a new hair! (I recommend copying and pasting your hair color into the bangs using the paper to the right of the FS menu)[/*]
[*]24 pants & skirts with a warm variation, so you can have vibrant colors in your clothes![/*]
[*]2 little bows![/*]
[*]A couple utility accessories such as a 'hair gap fixer', which is meant to be used with hairs that aren't for the Sweet Farmer, so you can still use them with as little bugs as possible. As well as an optional high waist accessory so you can raise the waist of your pants or lower the height of your crop top![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Modular Bag example, all of the blue clothing is actually white, I dyed blue so you can see what's going on![/b][/size]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53551/53551-1792032185-1506168686.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#444444][size=1][i]Caption: "Modular Bangs: Use the [u]Accessory tab[/u] of [u]FS[/u] to equip the bangs!" farmers with different hairs with bangs layered on top.[/i][/size][/color][/center]

[size=4][i][b]Pants and Shirts preview[/b][/i][/size]
[center][size=4][i][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53551/53551-1792032613-1927579087.png[/img][/b][/i][/size][/center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53551/53551-1792032630-188286049.png[/img]


[size=4][b][i]Installation (Cosplay/Co-Op)[/i][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Install Fashion sense[/b][/*]
[*]Download, extract and drop it into your mod folder like any other mod.[/*]
[*]This mod includes EVERYTHING, if you don't want to sort through a lot of folders or or only plan to use the Sweet/Gender Neutral shirts, install the 'Vanity' version and follow the instructions.[/*]
[/list][b][i][size=4]Installation (Vanity)[/size][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Install Fashion sense[/b][/*]
[*][b]Download the 'Vanity - Pants, Accessories & Hats' version, [/b]extract and drop it into your mod folder like any other mod. [b]Remove the 'Cosplay/Co-Op' version if you installed it, otherwise you'll get errors![/b][/*]
[*]You won't have shirts or hairs unless you install them too! Check if you want the Sweet (S), Gender Neutral (GN), or the Long Torso (L) versions. You can install all of them at the same time, pick the ones you want, install it like any other mod.[/*]
[*]Next, pick the Cold Hairs or the Warm Hairs, you can pick both of them at the same time.[/*]
[*][b]If you're playing in Co-Op, make sure all players have the same optional files + Vanity version.[/b][/*]
[*]You can play without the 'Vanity' add-on, but you won't have pants and instead will rely on vanilla pants. There's also some important fixes here which may help with the bigger issues with compatibility.[/*]
[/list]
[center][size=6][font=Courier New][color=#f1c232][i][b]known Issues[/b][/i][/color][/font][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]The shirts and hairs may appear white since you have to dye them![/*]
[*]There's missing Long Torso shirts, the ones missing are mostly crop tops![/*]
[*]There are bangs that are divided in 2 pieces due to layering issues. You need to find the top and bottom part, which usually are right beside each other. If you're struggling to put front bangs on top of the side bangs, add a new layer of bangs and add it on the later number. Tails, Buns and other up do extras do not require precise layering.[/*]
[*]When using hairs that aren't made for the Sweet Farmer, you'll have a gap in the back of the farmer and the sides of the torso. To fix this, use the "Hair Gaps Fixer", there are some different lengths that will match your current hair, try to color it as closely as you can, it may never be the exact same due to the different undertones.[/*]
[*][b]This mod does not work as intended if you're not using the Sweet Farmer. You're not allowed to port my clothes to other farmers.[/b][/*]
[/list][center][size=6][font=Courier New][b][i]You May See "friends"...[/i][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/vikich3rry/mods?gameId=1303]VikiCh3rry [/url]Has made many clothes for this FS pack, as well as letting me name some items after them! Viki's hoodie and the Cherry color swatch is named after them!
Glowingstar Has allowed me to add their hair 'Star' into the mod! The Obsidian color swatch is named after their OC!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Sprinton/mods?gameId=1303]Sprinton[/url] Has allowed me to add his hair 'Sprinton' into the mod!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/drawberry138/mods?gameId=1303]Drawberry[/url] Has allowed me to add her hair 'Berry' into the mod!
